newsitem.title: USA: TWA offers special and discount fares.
newsitem.headline: TWA offers special and discount fares.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc. Monday offered domestic sale fares ranging from $154 to $358 and discounts up to 50 percent off advance purchase fares on international flights.
The sale fares are available in more than 160 TWA markets, the carrier said.
The non-refundable sale fares require a 14-day advance purchase for U.S. flights and seven-day advance purchase for international flights. Tickets must be bought within three days of reservation.
Travel requires a Saturday night stay to most destinations and other restrictions apply, TWA said.

Tickets must be bought no later than Jan. 24. The first travel date for domestic cities is Feb. 3, and for international cities, Jan. 27. All travel must be completed by May 20 for domestic cities. International travel completion dates vary based on destination, it said.
For example, the New York-San Francisco roundtrip fare is $358 and the New York-Madrid roundtrip fare is $298.
TWA's stock was unchanged at $6.56 on the American Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
